title: Graduate CAD Technician
description: LotusWorks is an Engineering Services provider specializing in managing Commissioning, Construction Services, Calibration, Operations & Maintenance scopes of work within global manufacturing facilities. LotusWorks operates globally across EMEA and North America partnering with the world's leading manufacturers across the Semiconductor, Pharmaceutical & Biologics, Medical Device and Data Centre sectors. Our team of Engineering and Technical professionals is immersed in cutting-edge technologies and innovations. LotusWorks is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, integral to our people-first approach. You will assist the Mechanical Design Engineers with the updating of existing tooling drawings and associated documents. Responsibilities Generation of detailed drawings to the companies engineering specifications. Creation of detailed equipment documentation. Ensure equipment solutions are delivered within planned schedules and within budget. Ensure documentation/drawing standards for equipment meet the company’s requirements. Build Quality into all aspects of work by maintaining compliance to all quality requirements. Participates in the use of lean and Continuous Improvement tools in equipment designs and engineering systems. Any other duties or responsibilities that may be assigned to you in your role Skills Required Design software experience (SolidWorks) Literacy in computer operating systems and applications such as MS Office Suite Products (e.g., Windows, Word, Excel). An ability to work independently and as a member of a team in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This is a desk-based role and will not involve any solo mechanical design. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Education / Licenses / Certifications The successful candidate will have a Degree in Engineering or equivalent. Proof of education, licenses, and certifications will be required where applicable Benefits VHI Healthcare Cover Life Assurance Pension Contribution Training And Educational Assistance Annual GP Check-Up Extra Annual Leave Healthcare Screening Recognition Rewards LotusWorks is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.
